title: How we tested
subtitle: every check, its verdict, and the run-doc behind it — the test-record, not a hardcoded pass
how_to_read: Two kinds of test. The PILL LEDGER (below) is the per-card verdicts: Cold Read (is the card self-sufficient) + vs-Wild (does the instrument beat a naive reader). Each verdict links its RUN-DOC — the actual test you can open and read. A check with no verified run-doc renders INCOMPLETE; a green can only exist with a real recorded test behind it (seed_card_check.py fails loud if the run-doc is missing). The RELIABILITY MEASURES are the numbers (agreement / Krippendorff-alpha) with their evidence artifact + a verified flag.

honest_note: INCOMPLETE is honest, not a gap papered over: it means the check has not been RUN + recorded yet. Situate's Cold Reads are mostly INCOMPLETE (owed); Decompose/Connect are PASS (backed by VS_WILD_/COLDREAD_ run docs). Same-family reliability numbers are optimistic floors (§2.14).
